_comment: Real /api/song/lyric (pre-v1) response for NetEase 2699991455, trimmed. This endpoint flattens production credits into timestamped lines and pads the colon -- '作词 : 爆音常安' -- which is the shape that silently defeated the credit filter. Kept as a regression guard even though the provider now requests /api/song/lyric/v1.
